## Context

Platforms in scope: `core`, `ios`, `android`. The slice realises the `task-list` feature on a Crux shared core with HTTP + Key-Value adapters; both shells render the core's ViewModel directly and there is no shared design-system library. `tokens.yaml` and `assets.yaml` are operator-curated and consumed by the shell writers; when `tokens.yaml` is absent, each shell falls back to its platform-native palette (HIG for iOS, Material 3 for Android).

## Domain Model

### `App` struct

`TodoApp` — the top-level Crux app type.

### `Model`

```rust
pub struct Model {
    pub page: Page,
    pub tasks: Vec<Task>,
    pub add_form: AddTaskForm,
    pub pending_delete: Option<TaskId>,
    pub last_error: Option<DomainError>,
}
```

### `Page` (internal)

```rust
#[derive(Default)]
pub enum Page {
    #[default]
    Loading,
    TaskList,
    AddTask,
    Settings,
    Error,
}
```

`Page` derives `Default` only; no `Facet`, no `Serialize`. `#[default]` is on `Loading`.

### `Route` (shell-facing)

```rust
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Route {
    #[default]
    TaskList,
    AddTask,
    Settings,
}
```

`Route` enumerates user-navigable destinations only; internal states (`Loading`, `Error`) are excluded.

### `Event`

```rust
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub enum Event {
    Navigate(Route),
    ToggleTask(TaskId),
    RequestDelete(TaskId),
    ConfirmDelete,
    CancelDelete,
    AddTaskTitleChanged(String),
    AddTaskSubtitleChanged(String),
    SaveNewTask,
    #[serde(skip)] #[facet(skip)]
    TasksLoaded(Vec<Task>),
    #[serde(skip)] #[facet(skip)]
    PersistComplete,
}
```

Shell-facing variants are serialisable; internal callback variants are marked `#[serde(skip)] #[facet(skip)]` and used as effect callbacks.

### `ViewModel`

```rust
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub enum ViewModel {
    #[default]
    Loading,
    TaskList(TaskListView),
    AddTask(AddTaskView),
    Settings,
    Error(ErrorView),
}
```

### Per-page view structs

```rust
#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TaskListView {
    pub title: String,
    pub tasks: Vec<TaskRowView>,
    pub is_empty: bool,
    pub empty_title: String,
    pub empty_subtitle: String,
    pub pending_delete_title: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TaskRowView {
    pub id: TaskId,
    pub title: String,
    pub subtitle: Option<String>,
    pub completed: bool,
}

#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct AddTaskView {
    pub title: String,
    pub subtitle: String,
    pub title_error: Option<String>,
    pub can_save: bool,
}

#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ErrorView {
    pub message: String,
}
```

### `Effect`

```rust
#[derive(Effect)]
#[effect(facet_typegen)]
pub enum Effect {
    Render(RenderOperation),
    Http(HttpRequest),
    KeyValue(KeyValueOperation),
}
```

### Supporting types

```rust
#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct TaskId(pub String);

#[derive(Facet, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Task {
    pub id: TaskId,
    pub title: String,
    pub subtitle: Option<String>,
    pub completed: bool,
    pub created_at: String,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct AddTaskForm {
    pub title: String,
    pub subtitle: String,
    pub title_error: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum DomainError {
    NetworkUnavailable,
    InvalidTitle,
}
```

## Adapters

| Adapter | Needed? | Details |
|---|---|---|
| **Render** | Yes (always) | Drives `view()` updates after every `update()` arm. |
| **HTTP** (`crux_http`) | Yes | `GET /tasks`, `PATCH /tasks/{id}`, `DELETE /tasks/{id}`, `POST /tasks`. JSON request / response bodies. |
| **Key-Value** (`crux_kv`) | Yes | Local cache for offline operation. Keys: `tasks:list`, `tasks:pending-delete`. |
| **Timer / Time** (`crux_time`) | No | No scheduled behaviour. |
| **Server-Sent Events** (custom) | No | No streaming. |
| **Platform** (`crux_platform`) | No | Shells handle platform-specific behaviour locally. |

## API Contracts

When `contracts/http/tasks.yaml` exists, reference it; otherwise the endpoints are:

| Method | URL | Body / Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/tasks` | Returns `Vec<Task>`. |
| `POST` | `/tasks` | Body `{ title, subtitle? }`. Returns new `Task`. |
| `PATCH` | `/tasks/{id}` | Body `{ completed: bool }`. Returns updated `Task`. |
| `DELETE` | `/tasks/{id}` | 204 on success. |

All errors map to `DomainError::NetworkUnavailable` for the purposes of this fixture; the shell shows the `Error` view with a retry affordance.

## iOS Shell Details

Screen names and ViewModel variants come from `composition.yaml` (regenerated by `build` from this `design.md`); do not re-list them here.

- Navigation style: single `NavigationStack` rooted at the Task List view.
- Swipe-to-delete on each task row triggers `RequestDelete(id)`, which opens the same delete-confirmation dialog as the explicit delete action.
- HIG fallback when `tokens.yaml` is absent: system colours via `Color.primary`, dynamic type via system fonts.
- Inject hot-reload boilerplate must stay in place in `Core.swift`.

## Android Shell Details

- Navigation pattern: single activity, Jetpack Compose Navigation rooted at the Task List destination.
- Material 3 fallback when `tokens.yaml` is absent: dynamic colour scheme on Android 12+, baseline Material 3 palette otherwise.
- Edge-to-edge rendering with `WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window, false)` and explicit `Modifier.systemBarsPadding()` on the FAB.
- DI: Koin is not required (only Render + HTTP + KV adapters; the constructor-injected pattern suffices).
- UniFFI: `Application` class must call `System.setProperty("uniffi.component.shared.libraryOverride", "shared")` before any UniFFI class loads.

## Implementation Constraints

- Swift 6 / iOS 17+ deployment target.
- Kotlin 2.x / Jetpack Compose / Material 3 / minSdk 34.
- Java 21 LTS (not Java 25+ — Gradle compatibility).
- Crux, facet, and uniffi pins are taken from the active Vectis scaffold; the fixture uses the scaffold tool's embedded defaults.

## Dependencies

- `crux_core`, `crux_http`, `crux_kv` (versions pinned by the Vectis scaffold).
- iOS: `xcodegen`, `xcbeautify`, `swiftformat`, `cargo-swift` on the host; SF Symbols for system icons.
- Android: Android SDK + NDK, Java 21, Gradle, Material 3 Compose, `rust-android-gradle`.

## Risks / Open Questions

- Conflict resolution policy for `Persistence > Remote sync` is "most recent local change wins"; a future slice may introduce a richer reconciliation strategy.
- The Settings view is referenced from this slice but its content is owned by a future feature slice; this fixture leaves the Settings view as a placeholder.

## Notes

- `composition.yaml` is a build output and is regenerated from this `design.md` + `spec.md` on every `/spec:build`. It is not authored or committed at synthesis time.
- `tokens.yaml` and `assets.yaml` are operator-curated. The asset `empty-tasks-hero` referenced from REQ-001's empty-state scenario must be declared in `assets.yaml` before `/spec:build` runs; the SF Symbols / Material icons (`settings`, `chevron-right`, `plus`) resolve at call sites without being copied.
